episode.title: The Mystery Portal!
episode.story_summary: Samar discovers a glowing purple portal in his school locker. He calls Priyanka and Toto for help. The portal expands, and a mysterious blue hand reaches out—only to hand Samar a tiny banana. Toto is baffled. The portal vanishes, but when Samar says they'll check the locker again tomorrow, the locker whispers back 'Tomorrow...'

scenes.title: The Strange Locker
scenes.visual: Colorful modern school in Apex City. Samar walks through the hallway carrying his backpack. He notices his locker glowing with purple light and stops.

dialogue.samar: Wait... why is my locker glowing?

animation: Purple light flickers from the locker.

scenes.title: The Portal
scenes.visual: Samar opens the locker. Inside is a tiny swirling purple portal that looks like a miniature doorway into another dimension. Samar leans closer.

scenes.title: Call Priyanka & Toto
scenes.visual: Priyanka arrives with Toto Robo-Turtle. Toto scans the portal using his robotic scanner. Digital symbols appear around the portal.

dialogue.samar: I think my locker just became a doorway.
dialogue.toto: Scanning... scanning... Warning! This portal should not exist.

animation: Scanner light moves across the portal.

scenes.title: The Mystery Hand
scenes.visual: The portal suddenly becomes larger. Everyone steps backward. A mysterious blue hand slowly reaches through. Samar gets into a brave stance. The hand gives Samar a tiny banana.
animation: Samar's expression changes from brave to confused.

scenes.title: Toto's Reaction
scenes.visual: Toto examines the banana and scans it seriously.

dialogue.toto: I have absolutely no explanation for this.

animation: Samar looks suspiciously at the portal.

scenes.title: The Cliffhanger
scenes.visual: The portal disappears. Samar closes the locker. He looks at Priyanka and Toto. As he starts walking away, the locker whispers 'Tomorrow...' Samar freezes, eyes widen.

dialogue.samar: Okay... tomorrow, we're checking that locker again.

scenes.final_shot: Close-up of the locker. A tiny purple glow appears again.

samar.note: Keep Samar's underlying voice identical in every episode. Change only emotion and delivery.

toto.note: Toto should sound robotic enough to be recognizable but still warm and funny.

background_music: Start with light adventurous mystery music.
Build intensity when the portal appears.
Use a short dramatic rise when the blue hand appears.
Switch to playful comedy music when the banana is revealed.
End with a mysterious musical sting.

editing_rules: Keep the first 2 seconds visually interesting.
Cut quickly during the portal scene.
Pause briefly before the banana reveal.

hook.first_line: Wait... why is my locker glowing?
hook.goal: The viewer should immediately want to know what is inside.

ending_hook.effect: Creates a reason to watch Episode 0002.

episode.episode_0002_setup: The next episode begins with Samar returning to the school the following morning. The locker is no longer glowing. But something has been left inside—a tiny mysterious key.
episode.episode_goal: Episode 0001 should introduce the audience to Samar + Apex City + comedy + mystery + the beginning of a larger story. The audience should finish the Short thinking: 'What is inside the portal?'
